integrity: The proof is analytical and self-contained beyond standard numerical-range convexity. Supplementary finite diagnostics are not used as infinite proofs; no independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the homogeneous bilateral one-sided discrete Dirac operator on a complex Hilbert space, with c>0 and m>=0. It describes the centered-disk inradius and the numerical radius, not pseudospectra or boundary-potential perturbations. Prior general matrix-symbol results are acknowledged; publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Two distinct sharp numerical-range mass thresholds for the one-sided discrete Dirac operator
